items.example: I love spending time in nature.
items.simple: Everything that is outside and not made by people. Trees, rivers, and animals.

items.example: We went for a walk in the forest.
items.simple: A big place with many, many trees.

items.example: We want to climb that mountain.
items.simple: A very, very big hill. It goes up high.

items.example: There's a small lake near my village.
items.exampleTr: Köyümün yakınında küçük bir göl var.
items.simple: A big pool of water with land all around it.

items.example: The river is very cold in spring.
items.simple: Water that runs and runs along the ground.

items.example: The view from the top is amazing.
items.simple: What you see when you look far away.

items.example: Wow, what a beautiful view!
items.simple: You say this when you look out and it is very pretty.

items.example: There's an old tree in our garden.
items.simple: A tall plant with a thick brown body and green leaves.

items.example: These flowers smell so good.
items.simple: A pretty plant with red, yellow, or pink parts.

items.example: Let's sit on the grass.
items.simple: The soft green plants on the ground.

items.example: We walked up the hill.
items.simple: A small mountain. You can walk up it.

items.example: They live on a small island.
items.simple: Land with water all around it.

items.example: I can hear a bird outside.
items.simple: It has wings and it can fly. It sings.

items.example: She learned to ride a horse.
items.simple: A big animal. You can ride it. It runs fast.

items.example: There are cows in the field.
items.simple: A big animal on a farm. It gives you milk.

items.example: We saw hundreds of sheep on the road.
items.simple: A soft farm animal. It has white wool.

items.example: My daughter wants a pet rabbit.
items.simple: A little soft animal with long ears. It jumps.

items.example: There are so many insects here.
items.simple: A very small animal with six legs.

items.example: The mosquitoes were terrible last night.
items.simple: A tiny animal that flies. It bites you and makes you itch.

items.example: I'm afraid of snakes.
items.simple: A long animal with no legs. It slides on the ground.

items.example: You can see wild animals in the park.
items.simple: Not at home with people. It lives outside and can be scary.

items.example: Do you have any pets?
items.simple: An animal that lives with you at home.

items.example: Sorry, I can't stay. I'm allergic to cats.
items.simple: You do not feel good when you touch or are near cats.

items.example: I walk the dog before work.
items.simple: You go out and walk with your dog.

items.example: Let's go hiking this weekend.
items.exampleTr: Bu hafta sonu doğa yürüyüşüne çıkalım.
items.simple: You walk a long way outside, up hills and in nature.
